modules.moduleTitle: Urinary Diversions & Gastrointestinal Tract Acid-Base & Electrolyte Transport Mechanisms
modules.studyGuide:
## 1. Intestinal Segment Physiology in Urinary Diversion

當 Urological Surgery 採用 Intestinal Segment 進行 Urinary Diversion（如 Ileal Conduit, Sigmoid Diversion, 或 Ileocystoplasty）時，尿液長時間接觸腸道 Mucosa 會引發顯著的 Electrolyte 與 Acid-Base Disorders。

### Transport Pathways across Intestinal Mucosa
- **Apical SLC26A3 (DRA) Anion Exchanger**: 腸道 Epithelium 表面之 SLC26A3 負責吸收 Urinary Chloride (^-$) 並 Secretes Bicarbonate (^-$)。這是引發 **Hyperchloremic Metabolic Acidosis** 的核心分子機制。
- **Ammonium (^+$) Absorption**: 尿液中的 ^+$ 可取代 ^+$ 經由 Na-K-2Cl Cotransporter 或透過 Paracellular Pathway 被腸道 Mucosa 大量吸收，進一步在 Liver 轉化為 Urea，消耗 ^-$。
- **Potassium (^+$) Excretion & Hypokalemia**: 在 Ileal Conduit 與 Colonic Segment 中，腸道 Mucosa 會持續將 ^+$ Secretes 至尿液中。此外，Metabolic Acidosis 引起的 Renal ^+$ Wasting 與腸道 ^+$ 喪失，使 **Hypokalemia** 在 Ileal Conduit 患者中極為常見。

---

## 2. Masterclass Components

### Dynamic Feature / Receptor / Pathway Mapping Matrix
| Intestinal Segment | Primary Anion Exchanger | Acid-Base Disorder | Potassium Status | Solute Transport Characteristics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ileal Conduit** | Apical SLC26A3 (^-/HCO_3^-$) | Hyperchloremic Metabolic Acidosis | Hypokalemia (Common) | High ^-$ reabsorption, ^-$ secretion, moderate ^+$ absorption |
| **Sigmoid Diversion / Ureterosigmoidostomy** | Colonic Anion Exchangers | Severe Hyperchloremic Acidosis | Severe Hypokalemia & Hyperammonemia | Prolonged urine contact time, massive ^+$ & ^-$ reabsorption |
| **Ileocystoplasty** | Apical SLC26A3 & Na-K-2Cl | Mild-to-Moderate Metabolic Acidosis | Hypokalemia | Increased risk of obstruction & mucus plaque formation |

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Clinical Condition | Acid-Base Status | Serum Potassium | Primary Mechanism | Stomal Complication Risk |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unobstructed Ileal Conduit** | Mild Hyperchloremic Acidosis | Low-to-Normal ^+$ | Balanced ^-$ absorption & renal compensation | Low systemic toxicity |
| **Stomal Obstruction / Urinary Stasis** | Severe Hyperchloremic Acidosis | Severe Hypokalemia | Prolonged contact time $ightarrow$ Exacerbated ^+$ & ^-$ reabsorption | **Hyperammonemia & Encephalopathy** |
| **Upper Tract Calculi Formation** | Chronic Metabolic Acidosis | Hypokalemia | Alkaline Urine, Hypocitraturia, Hypercalciuria | Nephrolithiasis & Ureterolithiasis |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
 $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$ **Hyperammonemic Encephalopathy & Refractory Hyperchloremic Metabolic Acidosis**

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!CAUTION]
> **觀念避坑指南**:
> 1. **Hypokalemia vs Hyperkalemia in Diversions**: 腸道分流器官會主動分泌 ^+$ 至尿液中，故 Ileal Conduit 最常見的電解質異常為 **Hypokalemia** 而非 Hyperkalemia。
> 2. **Stomal Obstruction Exacerbating Encephalopathy**: 當 Stoma 發生 Obstruction 或 Retention 時，尿液滯留時間延長，腸道吸收 ^+$ 的總量呈現對數級暴增，會直接誘發 **Hyperammonemia**，臨床上易被誤診為 hepatic encephalopathy 或 stroke。
> 3. **Upper Tract Calculi Risk**: 長期 Hyperchloremic Metabolic Acidosis 會引發 Bone Resorption、Renal Hypocitraturia 與 Hypercalciuria，大幅增加 **Upper Tract Urolithiasis** 結晶沉澱與結石風險。

modules.moduleTitle: The Klotho-FGF23 Endocrine Axis & PTH-Wnt/β-Catenin Bone Remodeling Circuits in CKD-MBD
modules.studyGuide:
## 1. Molecular Circuits of Klotho, FGF23, and PTH in CKD-MBD

在 Chronic Kidney Disease - Mineral Bone Disorder (CKD-MBD) 病理生理學中，**Klotho-FGF23 Axis** 與 **PTH-Wnt/β-catenin Pathway** 佔據核心地位。

### The Klotho-FGF23 Axis Physiology & Deficiency Phenotype
- **FGF23 Co-receptor Function**: FGF23 由 Osteocytes 分泌，必須在 Renal Proximal Tubule 與 Parathyroid Gland 上結合 **α-Klotho** 與 FGFR1c 形成的 Complex，方能發揮 Phosphaturic 作用並 Downregulate CYP27B1 (lpha569Xhydroxylase)。
- **Klotho Deficiency Phenotype**: 在 Klotho-deficient mice（或基因缺失模型）中，FGF23 無法傳導訊號，產生 **FGF23 Resistance**。其 Biochemical Profile 表現為 **Hyperphosphatemia**, **Hypercalcemia**, 以及顯著升高之 **1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 (,25(OH)_2D_3$ / Calcitriol)**，與 FGF23 deficiency 完全相同。

### PTH Signaling & Molecular Bone Remodeling
- **Continuous PTH & Osteocyte Signaling**: 在 Secondary Hyperparathyroidism (SHPT) 患者中，持續高濃度的 PTH 作用於 Osteocytes 上的 PTHR1。
- **Inhibition of Wnt Antagonists (Sclerostin & Dkk-1)**: PTH 會顯著 **Inhibit** 由 Osteocytes 分泌的 Wnt signaling inhibitors —— **Sclerostin (SOST)** 與 **Dickkopf-1 (Dkk-1)**。
- **Activation of Wnt/β-catenin & RANKL Cascades**: Sclerostin 與 Dkk-1 被抑制後，解除了對 Osteoblast/Osteocyte 表面 LRP5/6 側受體的阻斷，進而 **Activate β-catenin Signaling**。活化的 β-catenin 上調 **RANKL** 表達，驅動 Pre-osteoclast 融合與活化，造成 High-turnover Bone Disease (Osteitis Fibrosa Cystica)。

---

## 2. Masterclass Components

### Dynamic Feature / Receptor / Pathway Mapping Matrix
| Target Receptor / Molecule | Key Effector / Source | Primary Downstream Pathway | Biological / Biochemical Effect | Alteration in CKD / SHPT |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **α-Klotho / FGFR1c Complex** | Renal Tubule / Parathyroid | CYP27B1 inhibition, Npt2a/2c downregulation | Phosphaturia, ,25(OH)_2D_3$ suppression | Early loss in CKD $ightarrow$ FGF23 Resistance |
| **PTHR1** | Osteocytes / Osteoblasts | lpha_s ightarrow$ cAMP / PKA | Downregulation of Sclerostin & Dkk-1 | Continuous elevation $ightarrow$ Wnt activation |
| **Sclerostin (SOST) & Dkk-1** | Osteocytes | LRP5/6 Wnt coreceptor inhibition | Inhibition of osteoblast differentiation | **Inhibited by PTH** $ightarrow$ Disinhibition of Wnt |
| **RANKL / RANK System** | Osteoblasts / Osteocytes | NF-κB activation in Pre-osteoclasts | Osteoclast maturation & active bone resorption | Upregulated by PTH & Wnt $ightarrow$ High turnover |

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Biochemical Marker | Klotho Deficiency / FGF23 Resistance | Advanced CKD (Without Klotho KO) | Primary Hyperparathyroidism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Serum Phosphate (^{3-}$)** | **Hyperphosphatemia** | Hyperphosphatemia | Hypophosphatemia |
| **Serum Calcium (^{2+}$)** | **Hypercalcemia** | Hypocalcemia / Normal | Hypercalcemia |
| **Serum Calcitriol (,25(OH)_2D_3$)** | **Markedly Elevated** | Suppressed | Elevated |
| **Intact PTH** | Normal / Variable | Markedly Elevated | Markedly Elevated |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
 $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$ **Accelerated Osteoclastic Bone Resorption & Osteitis Fibrosa Cystica**

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!CAUTION]
> **觀念避坑指南**:
> 1. **Klotho Knockout vs FGF23 Excess**: 常考觀念盲點！FGF23 Excess 會導致 *Hypophosphatemia* 與 *Suppressed Calcitriol*；但若 **Klotho 缺失**，因缺乏 Co-receptor，FGF23 完全無法發揮作用，導致 lpha569Xhydroxylase 失去負回饋，表現為 **Hyperphosphatemia + Hypercalcemia + Markedly Elevated Calcitriol**！
> 2. **PTH & Wnt Antagonist Signaling**: 許多考生誤以為 PTH 會刺激 Sclerostin。事實上，**PTH 是 Sclerostin 與 Dkk-1 的強效抑制劑**！PTH 透過 *抑制* Sclerostin/Dkk-1 來 *活化* Wnt/β-catenin signaling，進而帶動 RANKL 誘導的 Osteoclast 活化。

modules.moduleTitle: Physiological Renal Adaptations in Normal Pregnancy & Teratogenic Immunosuppression
modules.studyGuide:
## 1. Physiologic Renal & Hemodynamic Adaptations in Pregnancy

妊娠期間，受 Relaxin, Nitric Oxide, 與 Progesterone 的作用，孕婦血管網發生顯著的 Systemic Vasodilation，帶動一系列腎臟生理改變。

### Normal Renal Hemodynamic Changes
- **Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR) Surge**: GFR 在第一孕期即快速上升，至第二孕期達到巔峰（較孕前增加約 40%–50%）。Effective Renal Plasma Flow (ERPF) 增加幅度高達 50%–80%。
- **Serum Creatinine (SCr) Benchmark**: 由於 GFR 劇幅增加，正常孕婦的 Serum Creatinine 會顯著下降，正常值範圍落在 **0.4 to 0.6 mg/dL**。若孕婦之 SCr 達到 **1.0 mg/dL**，即代表已存在潛在的 Renal Impairment！
- **Reset Osmostat & Serum Sodium**: 妊娠使 Hypothalamic Osmotic Threshold 下移（Reset Osmostat）。Serum Sodium 正常生理性下降 **4 to 5 mEq/L**（維持在 134–138 mEq/L），Serum Osmolality 下降約 10 mOsm/kg。

### Immunosuppressive Medication Safety & Teratogenicity Profile
在懷孕或受孕期間，免疫抑制劑之 Teratogenicity 評估為重中之重：
- **Mycophenolate Mofetil (MMF) / Mycophenolic Acid**: **Strictly Contraindicated (Teratogenic)**！MMF 會引發特異性 Mycophenolate Embryopathy（包含 Craniofacial, Microtia, Cardiac, Limb Malformations）及 Spontaneous Abortion，必須在受孕前至少 6 週停藥並轉換。
- **Tacrolimus / Cyclosporine (Calcineurin Inhibitors)**: 於妊娠期間 **Compatible / Safe to Continue**，需密切監測 Blood Trough Levels。
- **Azathioprine**: 於妊娠期間 **Safe**（Fetal Liver 缺乏 Inosine Monophosphate Dehydrogenase，無法將 Azathioprine 轉化為活性代謝物）。
- **Prednisone / Prednisolone**: **Safe**（Placental  eta569XHSD2 會將其代謝成無活性的 Cortisone）。

---

## 2. Masterclass Components

### Dynamic Feature / Receptor / Pathway Mapping Matrix
| Parameter / Medication | Normal Non-Pregnant Range | Normal Physiologic Adaptation in Pregnancy | Clinical Clinical Significance / Safety Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR)** | 90–120 mL/min/1.73m² | **Increases by 40%–50%** (Peaks at 2nd Trimester) | Enhanced clearance of urea, creatinine, uric acid |
| **Serum Creatinine (SCr)** | 0.6–1.0 mg/dL | **Decreases to 0.4–0.6 mg/dL** | SCr $\ge$ 1.0 mg/dL indicates Abnormal Renal Function |
| **Serum Sodium (^+$)** | 138–142 mEq/L | **Decreases by 4–5 mEq/L** (134–138 mEq/L) | Result of Reset Osmostat (AVP release at lower osmolality) |
| **Mycophenolate (MMF)** | Immunosuppressant | N/A | **Strictly Contraindicated / Category X (Teratogenic)** |
| **Tacrolimus / Azathioprine** | Immunosuppressant | N/A | **Compatible in Pregnancy** (Requires therapeutic monitoring) |

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Laboratory Parameter | Normal Adaptation in Pregnancy | Pathologic Finding (e.g., Preeclampsia / AKI) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Serum Creatinine** | **0.4 – 0.6 mg/dL** | $\ge 0.8 - 1.0$ mg/dL (Indicates kidney injury) |
| **Serum Osmolality** | Decreased by ~10 mOsm/kg (270–280 mOsm/kg) | Normal or Elevated |
| **Serum Uric Acid** | Decreased in 1st/2nd trimester ($< 4.0$ mg/dL) | **Elevated ($> 5.5$ mg/dL)** (Early marker of Preeclampsia) |
| **Urinary Protein** | Normal up to 300 mg/24h | $> 300$ mg/24h or PCR $> 0.3$ g/g |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
 $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$ **Physiologic Drop in Serum Creatinine (0.4-0.6 mg/dL) & Reset Osmostat (Serum Na Drop by 4-5 mEq/L)**

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!CAUTION]
> **觀念避坑指南**:
> 1. **Serum Creatinine 1.0 mg/dL is Abnormal in Pregnancy**: 考生常誤認為 1.0 mg/dL 是正常值。在第二孕期，由於 GFR 增加了 50%，**SCr 1.0 mg/dL 已代表顯著的腎功能受損**！
> 2. **Teratogenicity of MMF vs Tacrolimus**: MMF 是極為強烈的 Teratogen，可造成Microtia, Craniofacial, and Cardiac Malformations；相反地，**Tacrolimus, Azathioprine 與 Prednisone 在孕期皆屬相對安全且可使用的藥物**。

妊娠期間，受 Relaxin, Nitric Oxide, 與 Progesterone 的作用，孕婦血管網發生顯著的 Systemic Vasodilation，帶動一系列腎臟生理改變。

### Normal Renal Hemodynamic Changes
- **Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR) Surge**: GFR 在第一孕期即快速上升，至第二孕期達到巔峰（較孕前增加約 40%–50%）。Effective Renal Plasma Flow (ERPF) 增加幅度高達 50%–80%。
- **Serum Creatinine (SCr) Benchmark**: 由於 GFR 劇幅增加，正常孕婦的 Serum Creatinine 會顯著下降，正常值範圍落在 **0.4 to 0.6 mg/dL**。若孕婦之 SCr 達到 **1.0 mg/dL**，即代表已存在潛在的 Renal Impairment！
- **Reset Osmostat & Serum Sodium**: 妊娠使 Hypothalamic Osmotic Threshold 下移（Reset Osmostat）。Serum Sodium 正常生理性下降 **4 to 5 mEq/L**（維持在 134–138 mEq/L），Serum Osmolality 下降約 10 mOsm/kg。

### Immunosuppressive Medication Safety & Teratogenicity Profile
在懷孕或受孕期間，免疫抑制劑之 Teratogenicity 評估為重中之重：
- **Mycophenolate Mofetil (MMF) / Mycophenolic Acid**: **Strictly Contraindicated (Teratogenic)**！MMF 會引發特異性 Mycophenolate Embryopathy（包含 Craniofacial, Microtia, Cardiac, Limb Malformations）及 Spontaneous Abortion，必須在受孕前至少 6 週停藥並轉換。
- **Tacrolimus / Cyclosporine (Calcineurin Inhibitors)**: 於妊娠期間 **Compatible / Safe to Continue**，需密切監測 Blood Trough Levels。
- **Azathioprine**: 於妊娠期間 **Safe**（Fetal Liver 缺乏 Inosine Monophosphate Dehydrogenase，無法將 Azathioprine 轉化為活性代謝物）。
- **Prednisone / Prednisolone**: **Safe**（Placental  eta569XHSD2 會將其代謝成無活性的 Cortisone）。

---

## 2. Masterclass Components

### Dynamic Feature / Receptor / Pathway Mapping Matrix
| Parameter / Medication | Normal Non-Pregnant Range | Normal Physiologic Adaptation in Pregnancy | Clinical Clinical Significance / Safety Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR)** | 90–120 mL/min/1.73m² | **Increases by 40%–50%** (Peaks at 2nd Trimester) | Enhanced clearance of urea, creatinine, uric acid |
| **Serum Creatinine (SCr)** | 0.6–1.0 mg/dL | **Decreases to 0.4–0.6 mg/dL** | SCr $\ge$ 1.0 mg/dL indicates Abnormal Renal Function |
| **Serum Sodium (^+$)** | 138–142 mEq/L | **Decreases by 4–5 mEq/L** (134–138 mEq/L) | Result of Reset Osmostat (AVP release at lower osmolality) |
| **Mycophenolate (MMF)** | Immunosuppressant | N/A | **Strictly Contraindicated / Category X (Teratogenic)** |
| **Tacrolimus / Azathioprine** | Immunosuppressant | N/A | **Compatible in Pregnancy** (Requires therapeutic monitoring) |

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Laboratory Parameter | Normal Adaptation in Pregnancy | Pathologic Finding (e.g., Preeclampsia / AKI) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Serum Creatinine** | **0.4 – 0.6 mg/dL** | $\ge 0.8 - 1.0$ mg/dL (Indicates kidney injury) |
| **Serum Osmolality** | Decreased by ~10 mOsm/kg (270–280 mOsm/kg) | Normal or Elevated |
| **Serum Uric Acid** | Decreased in 1st/2nd trimester ($< 4.0$ mg/dL) | **Elevated ($> 5.5$ mg/dL)** (Early marker of Preeclampsia) |
| **Urinary Protein** | Normal up to 300 mg/24h | $> 300$ mg/24h or PCR $> 0.3$ g/g |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
 $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$ **Physiologic Drop in Serum Creatinine (0.4-0.6 mg/dL) & Reset Osmostat (Serum Na Drop by 4-5 mEq/L)**

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!CAUTION]
> **觀念避坑指南**:
> 1. **Serum Creatinine 1.0 mg/dL is Abnormal in Pregnancy**: 考生常誤認為 1.0 mg/dL 是正常值。在第二孕期，由於 GFR 增加了 50%，**SCr 1.0 mg/dL 已代表顯著的腎功能受損**！
> 2. **Teratogenicity of MMF vs Tacrolimus**: MMF 是極為強烈的 Teratogen，可造成Microtia, Craniofacial, and Cardiac Malformations；相反地，**Tacrolimus, Azathioprine 與 Prednisone 在孕期皆屬相對安全且可使用的藥物**。

modules.moduleTitle: Differential Diagnosis of Saline-Responsive Metabolic Alkalosis vs Acidosis & Acyclovir Crystal Nephropathy
modules.studyGuide:
## 1. Saline-Responsive Metabolic Alkalosis & Acyclovir Crystal AKI

本章深度剖析低尿氯代謝性鹼中毒的診斷邏輯（包含對試題答案標註錯誤的勘誤正名），以及 Acyclovir 引起的 Intraluminal Crystal Precipitation 與 Dialysis 適應症。

### Differential Evaluation of Low Spot Urine Chloride ({Cl} < 20$ mEq/L)
在遇到 Metabolic Alkalosis 伴隨 High Bicarbonate (^- = 38$ mEq/L) 與 Hypokalemia 時，Spot Urine Chloride ({Cl}$) 是劃分 Saline-Responsive 與 Saline-Resistant 的核心指標：
- **Saline-Responsive ({Cl} < 20$ mEq/L)**: 代表 ECF Volume Depletion 且 Renal ^-$ Avid Reabsorption。常見病因包括：
  1. **Gastrointestinal ^+$ Loss**: Upper GI loss（Vomiting, Nasogastric Suction）。
  2. **Surreptitious Diuretic Withdrawal**: 隱密使用 Loop/Thiazide Diuretics 後，於**藥效消退停藥期**，腎臟展現強烈保留 $ 作用，{Cl}$ 降至 $< 20$ mEq/L。
  3. **Congenital Chloridorrhea**: 罕見腸道 ^-$ 吸收障礙。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Clinical Diagnostic Pearl (Diarrhea vs Vomiting / Diuretic Withdrawal)**:
> 臨床上需特別注意：**Diarrhea 會遺失大量 Bicarbonate，引發 Normal Anion Gap Hyperchloremic Metabolic Acidosis**！若患者呈現 Metabolic Alkalosis (High pH, High ^-$) 且 {Cl} < 20$ mEq/L，絕非 Diarrhea，而必須考量 Surreptitious Diuretic Use (停藥期) 或 Vomiting！

### Acyclovir Crystal Nephropathy & Emergent Hemodialysis Indications
- **Pathogenesis & Urinalysis**: High-dose IV Acyclovir 在 renal tubules 中因溶解度低而沉澱，形成 **Needle-shaped, Highly Birefringent Crystals**，阻塞 Tubular Lumen 導致 Acute Tubular Obstruction 與 AKI。
- **Indications for Emergent Hemodialysis**:
  1. Acyclovir 的 Protein Binding 極低（僅 **9% to 33%**），且 Volume of Distribution 小，能被 **Hemodialysis 極高效能地清除**。
  2. 當患者因 Acyclovir 積聚出現 **Severe Neurotoxicity / Encephalopathy（如 Coma, Seizures）伴隨 Oliguric AKI** 時，單純 Volume Hydration 無法及時降低血中藥物毒性，**Emergent Hemodialysis 為絕對最適切的治療指示 (Indicated)**。

---

## 2. Masterclass Components

### Dynamic Feature / Receptor / Pathway Mapping Matrix
| Clinical Entity | Primary Acid-Base Status | Spot Urine Chloride ({Cl}$) | Urine Sediment / Crystal Morphology | Hemodialysis Clearance Efficiency |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Vomiting / Gastric Suction** | Saline-Responsive Metabolic Alkalosis | **$< 20$ mEq/L** | Unremarkable / Hyaline casts | N/A |
| **Diuretic Abuse (Off-Phase)** | Saline-Responsive Metabolic Alkalosis | **$< 20$ mEq/L** | Unremarkable | N/A |
| **Diarrhea (Bowel GI Loss)** | **Hyperchloremic Metabolic Acidosis** | Variable | Unremarkable | N/A |
| **Acyclovir Nephropathy** | AKI / Secondary Electrolyte Imbalance | Variable | **Needle-shaped Birefringent Crystals** | **Extremely High (Low Protein Binding 9-33%)** |

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Feature | Saline-Responsive Alkalosis ({Cl} < 20$) | Saline-Resistant Alkalosis ({Cl} > 20$) | Diarrhea Induced Acidosis |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Blood pH & ^-* | High pH ($>7.45$), High ^-$ | High pH ($>7.45$), High ^-$ | **Low pH ($<7.35$), Low ^-* |
| **Spot Urine ^-* | **$< 20$ mEq/L** | $> 20$ mEq/L | Variable (Usually Low) |
| **Etiologies** | Vomiting, Diuretic Withdrawal | Bartter/Gitelman, Mineralocorticoid Excess | Diarrhea, Lower GI Fistula |
| **Volume Status** | ECF Depleted (Hypovolemic) | ECF Normal or Expanded | ECF Depleted |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
 $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$  $ightarrow$ **Emergent Hemodialysis (Rapid clearance due to low 9-33% Protein Binding)**

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!CAUTION]
> **觀念避坑指南**:
> 1. **Diarrhea DOES NOT Cause Metabolic Alkalosis**: 醫學鐵律！Diarrhea 腸道失去的是 ^-$，故必然導致 **Metabolic Acidosis**。若遇到高 ^-$ 且低尿氯 ({Cl} < 20$ mEq/L) 的 Saline-Responsive Alkalosis 病例，必定是胃液流失或利尿劑停藥期，絕不可混淆為 Diarrhea。
> 2. **Acyclovir Hemodialysis Clearance**: Acyclovir 蛋白質結合率極低（僅 9-33%），因此 **Hemodialysis 可極為有效地清除 Acyclovir**。當患者合併重度 AKI 與 Acyclovir Severe Neurotoxicity (such as Coma or Seizures)時，透析為救命的急診處置方案。
